feasibility.trade_sample: All 628 recorded capture-page URLs specify taker_only=true and filter_amount=0.01; not an unfiltered complete order-event tape.
feasibility.timestamp_resolution: integer epoch seconds; 23,370 same-second token0 timestamp groups, so no within-second order/queue inference
feasibility.cadence: Irregular; within scheduled first125min unique-token0 gaps median12s/p90 56s/p99 182s.
feasibility.quotes: Catalog contains bestBid/bestAsk/spread/lastTradePrice/outcomePrices, but not a time-resolved historical quote series. Do not use retrospective catalog values as decision-time features.
feasibility.depth: No price-level depth, order inserts/cancels/modifications, sequence numbers, queue positions, or own order/fill records in the inspected trade table.
feasibility.event_state: 195 PBP files and 35,460 timed-play rows are resident. Existing extractor supports pre-play score/down/possession/clock/field position. Receipt/schema review does not prove historical public availability; no PBP features in the initial price-only task.
feasibility.observability: Recorded trade and play event time is not the time a model could have received the information; catalog capture time is also not a historical quote timestamp.
feasibility.orientation: Raw selected market clobTokenIds[0], same exact token throughout. Raw order matches stored outcome_index; receipt token order differs in115games. Never combine complementary-token trades as synthetic executable quotes.
feasibility.quality: All195 trade CSV hashes and raw catalog compressed/decompressed hashes checked. Zero invalid price/size, noninteger timestamp, exact duplicate row, capture-window or condition/token/outcome-index mismatch observed.
feasibility.smallest_supported_claim: Historical filtered-trade-price prediction on the common endpoint-observed subset, not midpoint prediction, real-time edge, executable profit or passive fill prediction.

rationale_and_evidence.supported: Seconds-to-minutes price forecasting from order-book events is a legitimate trading research direction; event irregularity and latency matter.
rationale_and_evidence.not_supported: Our trade-only data contains comparable L1/L2/L3 information, a proprietary strategy, or evidence that automated researcher evolution works. Optiver explicitly distinguishes learned feature extraction from automating research.

rationale_and_evidence.supported: Prediction-market work includes pricing event-driven risk and providing two-sided liquidity.
rationale_and_evidence.not_supported: A revealed proprietary strategy or demonstrated profitability for this project.

rationale_and_evidence.supported: Fill likelihood and conditional post-fill return are distinct objectives; easier fills can come with worse adverse selection.
rationale_and_evidence.not_supported: Transfer of its Binance perpetual results or contrarian policy to these prediction-market contracts. Applicability requires separate tests.

rationale_and_evidence.supported: AARRI can complement granular research-capability evaluation.
rationale_and_evidence.not_supported: Market alpha, execution quality, or profitability; no AARRI job or task acquisition authorized/launched.

horizon_choice.reason: Five minutes is deliberately coarser than the sparse seconds-level tape and same-second ambiguity, and a30s endpoint window is10% rather than50% of the horizon. Stride300s gives non-overlapping target intervals. Five minutes does NOT have better endpoint coverage than60s; coverage is similar. No horizon chosen from MSE, target variance or prior horizon-screen winners.
horizon_choice.classification: Project choice and untested opportunity hypothesis, not literature consensus or optimality claim.

frozen_target.contract: Exactly raw selected moneyline market token0; outcome label name, winner and home/away identity are not features.
frozen_target.clock: Integer UTC event seconds. t = receipt scheduled event_start_utc +600+300*k, k=0..22; 10–120minutes after scheduled start, not inferred actual kickoff. Label latest endpoint is start+7500.
frozen_target.price: p(t)=sum(size_i*price_i)/sum(size_i) over same-token recorded trades with t-30 <= timestamp_i < t. Units USD per $1-settlement share; no complementary-token inversion.
frozen_target.label: y(t)=p(t+300)-p(t), with p(t+300) formed only from [t+270,t+300). No endpoint interpolation, price carry-forward, logit transform, winner label or forced zero label.
frozen_target.current_staleness: At least one valid recorded trade in [t-30,t); latest trade age1..30s at integer endpoints. Entire price window is trailing30s.
frozen_target.observation_mask: Create all4485anchor IDs first. Forecastability uses only past/current observations. Future window absence removes only the scoring label, not the forecast or population entry. Every model forecasts every forecastable anchor, and all are scored on exactly the same common observed-label IDs.
frozen_target.inclusion: Retain price endpoints0/1 if they occur and all195games including previously unresolved settlements. No deletion for direction, difficulty, small movement or model confidence.
frozen_target.failure_handling: Source/protocol failures fail the operation, not a scientifically convenient row subset. Model failure never changes the locked cohort. Preserve failed attempt; no automatic retry or same-ID reuse.
frozen_target.common_information: Only same-token trades in [t-900,t): timestamp, price, size, BUY/SELL plus fixed elapsed scheduled-start time. Identical raw900s information window for B1 and candidate; different learned/engineered representations are allowed. No contract/game/date/team identifiers as predictive features, final prices/outcomes, future trade intensity, event-state/PBP or external data.

ordinary.name: B1-FixedHGBRegressor
ordinary.status: Competent ordinary reference; not claimed globally strongest baseline.
ordinary.feature_rules: Every window is strictly trailing at t; broader windows contain the valid30s window. Size fraction = (BUY size-SELL size)/total size for inspected filtered trades, not order-book imbalance. No missing-price-as-zero imputation.
ordinary.fit_weights: 1/n_labelled_fit_rows_in_game; normalize weights to mean1 on each training fold.

candidate.name: C1-ControllerSelected-before-candidate-scoring
candidate.actual_parent: Controller declares the actual starting recipe/branch and contributors, separately from comparator incumbent. B1 is available as a starting implementation, not a compulsory parent. Prior settlement code can be reused but its scores are never a price-task comparator.
candidate.information: Same permitted raw trade history and labels as the ordinary baseline. Feature representation/model/loss may change within compute caps, but target, cutoff, mask, splits and external scorer cannot.
candidate.recipe_lock: Original decision, hypothesis, relevant memory, candidate source/test hashes and implementation/review resource reservation before any candidate check score.

validation.protocol: First22dates initial fit; four5-date expanding checks. All anchor rows for a game stay in the same block; fit only earlier dates and labels whose endpoint precedes the first check anchor. No random row split or within-game train/check mixing.
validation.fit_label_mask: Fit on observed labels on past dates only; same fit rows and event weights for ordinary and candidate; counts frozen before either fits.
validation.data_status: Repeatedly inspected Train Discovery. Reusing chronological checks is allowed research, not untouched OOS or independent confirmation.
validation.sample_accounting: 991 planned check rows from87games/20dates/7schedule weeks are not991independent events. Full195population,42dates,14weeks and each exclusion remain reported.

scoring.primary: Equal-game MSE: mean squared error within each scorable check game, then arithmetic mean across87check games. Games with no labels remain in coverage inventory, never receive a fabricated error.
scoring.prediction_transform: Score raw finite predicted price deltas, in USD-per-share units; no clipping, rescaling or post-score adjustment. Flag economically out-of-range implied prices separately. Missing/nonfinite predictions invalidate a candidate, never shrink its common sample.
diagnostics: Equal-game-weighted Pearson correlation; constant no-change predictor correlation=NA
MSE/paired delta for each of4folds,20dates and7NFLweeks
Coverage by game/date/week and zero-label reason codes
comparisons: Later child minus actual research parent
Later child minus locked task incumbent

uncertainty.method: Paired resampling of whole observed NFL-week clusters: retain every authorized check game and its anchors in each sampled week, recompute equal-game MSE with multiplicity. Date-block sensitivity similarly recomputes equal-game, not equal-date, metrics.
uncertainty.interval: percentile95%; exploratory conditional-on-trained-predictors interval, not retraining/selection-adjusted uncertainty
uncertainty.warning: Only7check weeks, and week14 has just1game in the authorized cohort. These are all observed games within each cluster, not the complete outside-cohort NFL schedule. Report cluster sizes/partial coverage; no statistical sufficiency or full-schedule claim.

scoring.discovery_keep: New task only: incumbent is the valid forecast with lowest primary equal-game MSE among B0/B1/admitted candidates; strict decrease>1e-12 updates it, otherwise no update. Secondary metrics never overrule MSE. Significance not required to explore; no formal promotion gate.
scoring.branch_pool: Separate from incumbent: retain globally2method-distinct valid research branches per active process, with concrete untested hypotheses and archived failures. REVERT/no-incumbent-update does not revoke exploration eligibility. Actual parent, comparison incumbent and triggering feedback are separate.
scoring.historical_rules: No change to any old settlement or legacy MSE scoring/KEEP/REVERT/coverage threshold.

execution_proposal.phase_1: First price scorecard: B0+B1+one Controller-generated C1. Establish data-to-prediction execution, not process superiority.
execution_proposal.includes: Task-specific implementation, tests, original Controller decision, review, materialization, fits, scoring and closeout; no off-clock repair.
execution_proposal.controller_request: gpt-6.1-sol as previous pilot; serving snapshot unknown unless actually verified.
execution_proposal.stop: Stop at first cap/deadline or a genuine unrepairable bounded failure; preserve partial and failed results. No expired-budget reuse.
execution_proposal.first_output: Per-anchor forecasts and source locks, common-mask independently recomputed price scorecard,4fold/20date/7week comparisons, coverage inventory, actual costs and limits. No invented candidate results.
execution_proposal.future_invocation: After implementation and fresh exact admission: python -B -m experiments.nfl_ingame_price_change_train_diagnostic --run-id <fresh-authorized-id> --candidate-source <reviewed-versioned-source>. Planned entrypoint does not yet exist; this is not a presently executable training command.
execution_proposal.authority: Proposal only. No new batch ID or paid authority granted here; exact runtime/account/source/data admission and window caps must be authorized before launch.

New300s task-specific contract retains zero-label games and adds full-week bootstrap. Existing binary87row evidence adapter is not drop-in.

Synthetic endpoint/strict-before/tie/orientation/missing-label tests; split/maturation/game-weighting/constant-correlation and shared-mask tests. Small data-only dry materialization before fitting. Independent source and paired-score review; no new harness service.

Reuse feedback_linked_loop, feedback_loop_runtime, original transaction/native worker, sole serial budget ledger, version registry and native journal. Add only task-specific allowed schema/module/preflight binding needed to accept regression outputs; do not relax scorer/data/authority guards or reconstruct services.

researcher_process_test.status: Separately admitted follow-up on the SAME frozen price task after first scorecard; not launched and not a prerequisite for initial prediction experiment.
researcher_process_test.fixed_arm: Same base Controller, initial memory/feedback and two-branch capacity. Can do normal multi-step hypothesis selection, implementation, prediction training and memory reuse; research tooling/workflow/selection-policy versions frozen. Not a one-shot weak opponent.
researcher_process_test.evolving_arm: Identical starting information and budgets; may additionally propose narrowly versioned researcher/tool/workflow/selection-policy changes, test and independently review them, and use admitted versions downstream. External scorer/task, permissions and protected data stay Supervisor-owned.
researcher_process_test.matching: Clone identical first-scorecard and preexisting history/memory, tools, dataset masks, model request/config and baseline. Keep arms isolated and sequential to respect one-worker limits; no feedback transfer between arms. Reset active pool identically to capacity2. Record requested and returned model identifiers; unknown serving snapshots prevent claiming a verified exact underlying-snapshot match.
researcher_process_test.cost_accounting: Both arms charge implementation, review, failed attempts, Controller usage, execution, scoring and bookkeeping inside total wall caps; baseline refit counts inside each12fit cap. Shared task/audit setup cost reported separately and allocated equally. AI account monetary cost may be unmetered, so record tokens and do not label it fully cost-matched without evidence.
researcher_process_test.required_feedback_dependency: At least first real candidate score/failure independently verified -> original next decision citing a specific finding -> new candidate or reviewed R/H change -> second executed evaluation. Preplanned parallel models cannot count as feedback-linked steps.
outcomes: Prediction MSE of predeclared final selection plus all candidates
Repeated mistakes and demonstrable negative-finding reuse
Downstream adoption/effect of separately versioned R/H changes
researcher_process_test.attribution: C predictor changes, R researcher-policy/tool changes, H execution/feedback capacity changes and M memory updates logged separately; new target is task/kernel K. Human/Supervisor configuration repairs are not agent self-evolution. Credit assists branch choice but never changes prediction scores.
researcher_process_test.limitations: One matched pair is a pilot, not mechanism superiority. Multiple independently initialized paired trajectories and later frozen prospective events are required before stronger claims. Incentive on/off ablation is separate; no multi-factor attribution from one result.
researcher_process_test.authorization: Requires its own matched two-arm batch/model/payload authority. Do not infer it from the first scorecard or old45minpilot04 grant.

claims.allowed_after_valid_phase1: A model did/did not improve historical five-minute recorded-trade-price prediction on the common opened-Train sample.
not_established: Passive fill probability or queue model
Research-process superiority or autonomous co-evolution from Supervisor-written audit code
claims.future_trading_requirements: Before any trading evaluation: verified historical/publish/receive quotes and sizes/depth, applicable fee schedule, measured latency, order type and queue/fill assumptions with partial/cancel outcomes, entry/exit/timeout rules, size/position/inventory limits. No free midpoint fills or guaranteed passive fills. Fill probability and conditional post-fill markout are separate targets.
claims.deferred: Full market making, volatility strategies, new source acquisition and prospective collection need separate scopes/authority. Formal new-data confirmation does not block authorized Train price research.

separation_of_evidence.literature_supported: Short-horizon order-event forecasting is relevant; institutional work includes liquidity/risk pricing; fill likelihood and post-fill return can conflict in crypto.
separation_of_evidence.project_parameters: 195cohort; fixed token0; scheduled10–120min grid;300s horizon/stride;30s VWAP;22+4x5dates; fixed HGB recipe;2000bootstrap/seed314159;45min phase1/8fits; later matched arms45min/12fits each.
separation_of_evidence.untested_hypotheses: Recorded trades contain incremental forecast information; co-evolving process uses evidence more effectively than a capable fixed process; any later learned advantage transfers to executable prices or new events.
